title: Space kid shows copper bracelet worn in channeling sessions

tellings.quote: She whipped out this bracelet she had that was like a copper a little copper plate on this bracelet that she said like they all had to wear when they were doing their channeling sessions with him decades later.

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi says that while filming an interview with a woman who had been one of the "space kids", young people who took part in channeling sessions in the 1970s, meaning sessions where people said they spoke messages from other beings, she pulled out a bracelet with a little copper plate on it. She told him, decades later, that they all had to wear these bracelets during their channeling sessions with the man who led them, who is described as a CIA scientist said to have contacted an alien council. Malatzi tells Michels this as something he saw himself.
